messages:
kevin: Quick check before I flip ff.request_coalesce_v2 to prod — planning incremental rollout today. Can we confirm roll criteria & rollback steps? :eyes:

lina: +1. Need perf sigs and safety gates. What audience and ramp schedule?

kevin: Plan: 0.5% traffic internal-only (internal orgs) for 10m, then 2% customer canary slice for 30m, then 10% gradual over 2h if metrics OK. Toggle path: admin-console or featureflags API.

mike: Can you share the smoke perf run numbers? Local load test results?

kevin: Ran a 15m canary on staging (traffic shape replay). Median gen latency -4%, p95 +7% under bursty QPS. Cache hit ratio improved from 12%->31%. No error spike seen. Logs had a handful of kv-warmup timeouts (~6 total).

sara: p95 +7% worries me. Did you try reducing batching window or limiting adaptive-coalesce concurrency?

kevin: Yes — lowering batch window to 10ms drops p95 back near baseline in the test. We have param ff.request_coalesce_v2.batch_window_ms that we can set per-audience. Default will be 20ms; canary will use 10ms.

julia: Also add short-circuit fallback to old path on error rate > 0.5% or p95 > baseline + 20%. ops-bot can auto-toggle to safe model variant.

ops-bot: FYI: Added runbook link -> https://redwood.runbooks/ff-coalesce-rollout. Trigger conditions: error_rate >0.5% (1m), p95_latency_delta >20% (5m) => auto-rollback.

mike: Monitoring queries to watch (PromQL):
```promql
sum(rate(http_request_errors[1m])) by (route) / sum(rate(http_requests[1m])) by (route) * 100
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
sum(rate(cache_hits[1m])) / sum(rate(cache_lookups[1m]))
```

lina: Also watch cost metrics: token_cost_per_minute and avg_tokens_per_request. If cost delta > +10% stop.

kevin: Rollback command (admin API):
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://admin.redwood.internal/flags/ff.request_coalesce_v2/toggle \
  -d '{"state":"off","reason":"auto-rollback"}'
```

kevin: Manual quick kill: set audience to "internal-only" then flip to off after confirming no canary org traffic.

julia: Pre-roll checklist:
- confirm canary org list (kevin)
- update dashboards + alert thresholds (mike)
- ensure oncall aware and Slack incident channel pinned (sara)
- smoke deploy for 10m (kevin)

kevin: Canary orgs: emma-inc, testlabs, redwood-internal. I'll post the list to the rollout doc.

mike: I'll add alert: p95_delta > 15% for 5m (warn) and >20% for 1m (critical). Also track cache_hit_ratio and kv_timeout_count.

sara: I'll be oncall during ramp and ready to flip if alarms fire. Please ping me @sara when you start. :thumbsup:

kevin: Starting internal-only canary in 10m. Will leave a status update at +10m and +40m.

oncall-bot: Scheduled: ff.request_coalesce_v2 canary -> 2065000060 (start) by kevin. Reminder in 10m.

kevin: +10m update: internal-only stable. p50 -3%, p95 +2%, cache_hit_ratio 28%. No kv timeouts. Proceeding to 2% customer canary in 5m.

lina: :raised_hands: good to proceed.

kevin: +40m update: 2% customer canary running. p50 -3.5%, p95 +6% for one route (chat/generation). Error rate steady. Alert thresholds set.

mike: Seeing small p95 skew during spike period. I recommend keeping batch_window=10ms for customer canary and re-evaluating at 10% ramp.

kevin: Noted. I'll hold 10% ramp until we validate at 2h window per plan.

sara: If any critical alert fires, I'll perform rollback and post incident stub.

kevin: Thanks everyone. I'll post final status and clean up flags/params after stabilization. :white_check_mark:
